label: fibrous
reason: Texture sense is useful, but fibre abundance and stiffness are unspecified; keep separate from root-system architecture.

label: fibrous-rooted
reason: Architecture of a root system, not merely branching of one root; verify absence of a dominant taproot and the bearer scope.

label: beaked
reason: Needs an apex-region or projection definition and separation from mucronate/rostrate senses across organs.

label: horned
reason: Horn-like projections can have different anatomical origins; shape does not establish homology.

label: zigzag
reason: Specify alternating bends of an axis, not leaf arrangement; angular thresholds remain qualitative.

label: umbelliform
reason: Resemblance to an umbel does not imply an actual umbel; umbellate-racemose must not be treated as an exact lexical rule.

label: medium-sized
reason: No fixed reference population or size interval; context-relative value cannot justify numeric bounds.

label: pectinate
reason: Comb-like pattern may concern lamina divisions, branches or hairs; confirm bearer-specific homology and scope.

label: indeterminate
reason: Current definition is inflorescence-specific; growth duration and monopodial architecture are related but not equivalent.

label: subterranean
reason: Position relative to ground depends on stage and environment; hypogeal can specifically describe germination.

label: aerial
reason: Above-ground position is contextual; some aerial organs later contact the ground.

label: androgynous
reason: Mixed-sex inflorescence sense may require male-above-female ordering in sedges; verify taxon-specific usage.

label: virgate
reason: Straight wand-like axes and broom-like branching are not identical; review synonym and architectural boundaries.

label: palm-like
reason: Analogy to palm habit is not taxonomic identity; branching and trunk number vary among palms.

label: claw-shaped
reason: Distinguish a curved claw-shaped projection from the narrow basal claw of a petal.

label: pea-sized
reason: Analogy has no universal diameter; source text does not license an asserted 5–10 mm range or exact chickpea equivalence.

label: cherry-like
reason: Analogy may concern colour, shape, texture or size; intended dimension must be established from each source.

label: straggly
reason: Loosely spreading irregular architecture lacks an operational boundary relative to sprawling and scrambling.

label: submerged
reason: Requires water-surface and developmental context; distinguish fully submerged from emergent plants.

label: floating
reason: Requires water-surface context and distinction between floating organs and a wholly free-floating plant.

label: membranous
reason: Distinguish thin/translucent membranous from chartaceous (papery); current annotations also map chartaceous here.

label: scarious
reason: The draft distinguishes dry membranous texture, but boundaries from membranous and chartaceous need consistent botanical criteria.

label: pilose
reason: The draft specifies relatively long soft hairs; length, density and stiffness boundaries from puberulous, villous and hirsute remain qualitative.

label: puberulous
reason: Puberulent is retained as an exact spelling variant; the very-short-hair boundary remains qualitative, and hirtellous/hispidulous are only related.

label: hirsute
reason: Distinguish hispid from hirsute; current annotations conflate them.

label: villous
reason: Villose/villous spelling variation is resolved; the long-soft-hair value still needs a consistent boundary from pilose and other indumentum values.

label: glabrescent
reason: Developmental loss of hairs, not an atomic synonym of glabrous; preserve temporal context. Glabrate has differing glossary senses (nearly glabrous versus previously hairy); retained as related, not exact.

label: subglabrous
reason: Define degree boundary relative to glabrous and sparse pubescence.

label: mucronate
reason: The draft specifies an abruptly differentiated terminal point; apex-region modelling and the boundary from acute/acuminate still need review.

label: mucronulate
reason: Decide whether a separate value or qualified mucronate is justified.

label: obcordate
reason: The reversed heart-shaped outline is defined; verify plane-outline scope and orientation relative to the organ base and apex.

label: lyrate
reason: The draft specifies a large terminal lobe and smaller lateral lobes; confirm incision and relative-lobe criteria across floras, without equating it to obovate.

label: scabrous
reason: Roughness is distinguished from hairiness in the draft; the responsible surface outgrowths and boundaries from finer scabridulous forms remain to be reviewed.

label: papillose
reason: Compare with PATO papillary/papillomatous and PO papilla; distinguish covering from cell shape.

label: tuberculate
reason: Decide whether quality or presence of tubercles gives the intended semantics.

label: sulcate
reason: The draft narrows PATO furrowed to longitudinal furrows; verify that this botanical distinction warrants a separate value before upstream submission.

label: ribbed
reason: The draft narrows PATO ridged to longitudinal ribs; verify boundaries from venation and whether existing ridged can express the intended meaning.

label: imbricate
reason: Overlapping neighbouring structures are defined, but the arrangement needs collection/adjacency semantics and explicit bud-aestivation versus leaf scope.

label: appressed
reason: Requires the surface or organ against which the bearer lies.

label: stipitate
reason: The draft states presence of a stipe; review a structural presence expression and stalk homology rather than equating stipes with petioles or pedicels.

label: amplexicaul
reason: Existing FLOPO clasping has amplexicaul as a NARROW synonym; prefer a stem-qualified reuse if adequate.

label: connate
reason: Fusion among organs of the same kind; retain relational semantics and distinguish adnate.

label: free
reason: Existing PATO related synonym and organ-specific PO classes; scope lack of fusion to the relevant structures.

label: concolorous
reason: Needs the two surfaces/parts being compared, not a single absolute colour.

label: discolorous
reason: Two surfaces/parts of differing colour; distinguish from pathological PATO discolored.

label: monoecious
reason: Whole-plant sexual system: male and female reproductive structures on the same plant; specify lifecycle/taxon scope.

label: dioecious
reason: Whole-plant sexual system: male and female reproductive structures on different plants; distinguish bryophyte usage.

label: unifoliolate
reason: The draft specifies a one-leaflet compound leaf; review anatomical evidence distinguishing it from a simple leaf, rather than treating it as count one alone.

label: extra-axillary
reason: Position relative to axil; retain reference structure and distinguish from axillary.

label: resinous
reason: PATO adhesive has resinous only as RELATED synonym. Distinguish resin content/exudation from stickiness.

label: subcoriaceous
reason: The draft specifies a somewhat leathery texture; the degree boundary from coriaceous and membranous lacks an operational criterion.

label: turbinate
reason: The draft defines a three-dimensional spinning-top shape; exact equivalence or a narrower relation to obconical still needs review.

label: pinnatifid
reason: The draft describes pinnate lamina incisions; incision-depth boundaries from pinnatilobed and pinnatisect need consistent criteria across floras.

label: canescent
reason: Grey-white indumentum combines hairiness and colour; choose defined expression versus primitive value.

label: divaricate
reason: Relational branching angle/spreading pattern; compare existing spreading/divergent.

label: serrulate
reason: The draft describes fine serration; tooth size is relative, so a separate value versus degree-qualified serrate remains unresolved.

label: accrescent
reason: Enlargement during maturation; requires developmental/temporal semantics.

label: valvate
reason: Specify aestivation or opening/valve sense in each source; not one unrestricted meaning.

label: multiseriate
reason: The draft specifies several rows; row identity and geometry need an arrangement model distinct from the number of individual parts.

label: bilabiate
reason: Two-lipped structure; distinguish shape from presence of two organ lobes.

label: strigose
reason: The draft specifies stiff, straight, appressed hairs; boundaries from hirsute/hispid and a compositional hair-shape/orientation definition need review.

label: barbellate
reason: The draft specifies fine barbs; confirm the bearer scope (hair, bristle or awn) and a structural presence expression versus a primitive quality.

label: verruculose
reason: The draft specifies fine wart-like projections; their size boundary and relation to verrucose and tuberculate remain qualitative.

label: biseriate
reason: Two rows; evaluate a counted-arrangement expression shared with uni-/multiseriate.

label: uniseriate
reason: One row; evaluate a counted-arrangement expression shared with bi-/multiseriate.

label: strigulose
reason: Fine strigose indumentum; decide separate value versus degree qualifier.

label: dimorphic
reason: Two morphological forms in the specified organ population; specify dimension and population.

label: autoicous
reason: Bryophyte sexual system; distinguish gametophyte arrangement from flowering-plant monoecy.

label: andromonoecious
reason: Whole-plant sexual system; male plus bisexual flowers, not a flower-sex value.
